name: Raising and Accelerating MSME Performance (RAMP) Interventions: Reimbursement of GST Amount for Promoting Destination Wedding- DNH&DD
state: Dadra & Nagar Haveli And Daman & Diu
benefit: This intervention aims to promote the tourism sector in the Union Territory by incentivising destination weddings organised through local MSME service providers. Under this intervention, MSMEs-Service Provider operating in the UT can claim reimbursement of the GST component paid by clients hosting destination weddings at their premises.
